{"CommandLine":"python -c "
import os
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch()
    
    # 1. English
    page = browser.new_page()
    url_en = 'file:///' + os.path.abspath('neocarbon_flyer.html').replace('\\\\', '/')
    page.goto(url_en, wait_until='networkidle')
    page.pdf(path='neocarbon_flyer.pdf', format='A4', print_background=True, margin={'top': '0', 'bottom': '0', 'left': '0', 'right': '0'})
    print('Rendered neocarbon_flyer.pdf')
    
    # Screenshot pages
    sheets = page.query_selector_all('.page-sheet')
    for i, s in enumerate(sheets):
        s.screenshot(path=f'preview_en_page_{i+1}.png')
        print(f'Captured preview_en_page_{i+1}.png')
        
    # 2. French
    page_fr = browser.new_page()
    url_fr = 'file:///' + os.path.abspath('neocarbon_flyer_fr.html').replace('\\\\', '/')
    page_fr.goto(url_fr, wait_until='networkidle')
    page_fr.pdf(path='neocarbon_flyer_fr.pdf', format='A4', print_background=True, margin={'top': '0', 'bottom': '0', 'left': '0', 'right': '0'})
    print('Rendered neocarbon_flyer_fr.pdf')
    
    sheets_fr = page_fr.query_selector_all('.page-sheet')
    for i, s in enumerate(sheets_fr):
        s.screenshot(path=f'preview_fr_page_{i+1}.png')
        print(f'Captured preview_fr_page_{i+1}.png')

    browser.close()
